text.content: What the presentation is

rich_text.plain_text: What the presentation is

text.content: The Sprint 4 presentation is the main evaluation moment for Course 2A. It is not a walkthrough of your canvas nodes or a line-by-line explanation of your system prompt. It is a demonstration and defense of a working system — showing that you built something functional, explaining why you made the decisions you made, and communicating what the agent does and why it matters in a business context.

text.content: Code Clinic

rich_text.plain_text: Code Clinic

text.content: You have access to a Code Clinic session before presentation day. Use it. Bring your Chatflow, a list of any failures from your Sprint 3 validation, and any architectural questions you have not been able to resolve on your own. The Code Clinic is a support session — the right place to debug a broken tool description, work through a memory edge case, or pressure-test your architecture defense before the live presentation.
